caseName: Cossett v. Merchants & Mechanics Federal Savings & Loan Ass'n
caseNameFull: James Harold COSSETT, et ux. v. MERCHANTS AND MECHANICS FEDERAL SAVINGS & LOAN ASSOCIATION

opinions.text: The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
